e.title: Renext (R)
e.summary: 再保险极值外推 R 包（CRAN）：GPD/泊松过程拟合、再保层定价与极端事件重现
e.body: Renext（R CRAN）用更新方法（renewal method）做极值外推：拟合广义帕累托（GPD）与泊松/更新过程模型，用于再保险定价——超额损失再保层（XL）的定价、极端事件重现期与尾部概率，支持保险业常用数据格式（含阈值与删失数据）。对 RIAA：再保险与极端损失定价的专业工具——与 [[reinsurance]]（概念）、[[extremeloss]]（极端损失）、[[insurance-evt]]（极值索赔 EVT）配套；R 侧极值族另见 [[evir]]、[[mev]]、[[extremes]]。
e.verified_note: CRAN 官方页核实：再保险极值外推（GPD+更新过程，XL 再保定价）
e.summary_en: Reinsurance extreme-value extrapolation R package (CRAN): GPD/Poisson-process fitting, excess-of-loss layer pricing and extreme-event return periods
e.summary_hk: 再保險極值外推 R 包（CRAN）：GPD/泊松過程擬合、再保層定價與極端事件重現
e.body_en: Renext (R CRAN) performs extreme-value extrapolation with the renewal method: it fits generalised Pareto (GPD) and Poisson/renewal-process models for reinsurance pricing — excess-of-loss (XL) layer pricing, return periods and tail probabilities of extreme events — and supports insurance-style data formats (with thresholds and censored data). For RIAA: a specialised tool for reinsurance and extreme-loss pricing — pairs with [[reinsurance]] (the concept), [[extremeloss]] (extreme losses) and [[insurance-evt]] (EVT for claims); other members of the R extreme-value family: [[evir]], [[mev]], [[extremes]].
e.body_hk: Renext（R CRAN）用更新方法（renewal method）做極值外推：擬合廣義帕累托（GPD）與泊松/更新過程模型，用於再保險定價——超額損失再保層（XL）的定價、極端事件重現期與尾部概率，支持保險業常用數據格式（含閾值與刪失數據）。對 RIAA：再保險與極端損失定價的專業工具——與 [[reinsurance]]（概念）、[[extremeloss]]（極端損失）、[[insurance-evt]]（極值索賠 EVT）配套；R 側極值族另見 [[evir]]、[[mev]]、[[extremes]]。
